children: Sprout Red International filed for an initial public offering on the Nasdaq Capital Market under the ticker FYH. The Cayman Islands-based company develops and sells active sprouted-grain foods alongside smart germination and cooking hardware. Prior to this offering, there has been no public market for its ordinary shares.

Sprout Red International develops and markets active sprouted-grain staple foods, led by high-GABA, low-GI sprouted brown rice, and complements them with smart germination and cooking equipment for home and commercial use. Its product portfolio includes core sprouted grains (white, red, black, purple formulas with GABA >35 mg/100g and GI ≤55), deep-processed items such as grain powders and ready-to-drink beverages, and technical services including cultivation standards and equipment technology licensing.

The company emphasizes a full-chain model spanning upstream ecological planting bases, intelligent midstream production, and multi-channel downstream distribution. It highlights proprietary bio-activation sprouting and freshness-preservation technologies, over 40 patents (including international PCTs), ISO 22000 and HACCP certifications, FDA food facility registration, and an EU EFSA novel food filing. Management positions the brand to leverage consumer health trends and ESG priorities while building defensible advantages through technology, standards, and integrated hardware-software-food ecosystems.
: Global biotech food market was about $45.8 billion in 2024 and is projected to exceed $107.3 billion by 2032.
: Company aims to be a standard-setter and leader in the sprouted-grain category with a dual product model (food + equipment).
: Traditional agri-food giants (e.g., Wilmar, CP Group, Marubeni) and functional/biotech food players.
: Rising whole-grain and low-GI demand, ESG-driven purchasing, and technologies such as AI-enabled process control, precision fermentation, and CRISPR.
: Private-domain user repurchase rate reported at over 50%
: Standardized ecological planting bases in premium rice regions; self-built intelligent production bases
: Laying groundwork across Southeast Asia, North America, and Europe; applied for Nasdaq listing
: Participation in industry bodies (e.g., ICC division for active grains) and FAO-related programs

: Intelligent sprouting cycle reduced to 13–19 hours; germination rate >90%; per-capita production capacity 5x traditional lines; production loss controlled within 8%; nutrient retention ≥95% over 6-month shelf life; >40 core patents; ISO 22000 and HACCP certified; FDA food facility registration; EFSA novel food filing
: Technical R&D; market promotion and brand building; business expansion and strategic layout; team building and talent recruitment
